title: Who Gets Heard? Rethinking Fairness in AI for Music Systems

bias_targets.methodology: Qualitative analysis using unstructured interviews with researchers, practitioners, and professionals in music and AI to identify socio-cultural inequities, misrepresentation of Global South traditions, and the homogenization of non-Western musical forms.

Evaluating design choices in music-AI systems, such as the flattening of diverse musical traditions into catch-all labels (e.g., 'world' or 'ethnic'), culturally narrow prompt interfaces, and the reliance on Western tonal and rhythmic defaults in symbolic formats like MIDI.
